A0.linguistic_complexity: Very limited language; short memorized or highly supported phrases.
A0.cognitive_demand: Concrete recognition, matching, recall, and simple personal meaning.
A0.interaction_expectation: Highly supported pair/group interaction with predictable turns.
A0.scaffolding: Very high; models, sentence frames, visuals, repetition, and guided practice.
A0.autonomy_expectation: Very low; learners depend on clear models and structured choices.
A0.grammar_precision: Basic accuracy of taught forms is prioritized over range.
A0.fluency_expectation: Emerging; short utterances with pauses are acceptable.
A0.register: Simple everyday language in familiar contexts.
A0.assessment_expectation: Demonstrate controlled understanding and basic meaningful production with strong support.

A1.linguistic_complexity: Simple sentences and familiar functional language.
A1.cognitive_demand: Concrete identification, recall, selection, and simple application.
A1.interaction_expectation: Structured pair/group interaction using familiar language.
A1.scaffolding: High; models, prompts, frames, examples, and guided practice remain important.
A1.autonomy_expectation: Limited; learners can make simple choices within familiar tasks.
A1.grammar_precision: Basic control of taught structures with frequent support.
A1.fluency_expectation: Short connected production with noticeable pauses.
A1.assessment_expectation: Show basic comprehension and communicate simple personal information or needs.

A2.linguistic_complexity: Simple connected sentences with a growing range of familiar structures.
A2.cognitive_demand: Application, comparison, sequencing, and simple problem solving.
A2.interaction_expectation: Meaningful pair/group interaction with some spontaneous language.
A2.scaffolding: Moderate; prompts and models support performance but do not carry the task.
A2.autonomy_expectation: Moderate; learners can complete familiar tasks with limited support.
A2.grammar_precision: Functional control of taught structures; meaning remains more important than perfect accuracy.
A2.fluency_expectation: Can produce short connected speech despite pauses and reformulation.
A2.register: Everyday social, personal, and practical contexts.
A2.assessment_expectation: Demonstrate functional comprehension and communication in familiar situations.

B1.linguistic_complexity: Connected language with a functional range of common structures and vocabulary.
B1.cognitive_demand: Explanation, comparison, justification, sequencing, and familiar problem solving.
B1.interaction_expectation: Sustained pair/group interaction with increasing spontaneous contribution.
B1.scaffolding: Moderate to low; support is targeted rather than continuous.
B1.autonomy_expectation: Increasing; learners can manage familiar communicative tasks independently.
B1.grammar_precision: Generally controlled use of familiar grammar with errors that do not usually block meaning.
B1.fluency_expectation: Can maintain connected speech with some hesitation and reformulation.
B1.register: Everyday, academic, and workplace contexts with basic register awareness.
B1.assessment_expectation: Demonstrate independent functional communication and explain or support ideas with relevant detail.

B2.linguistic_complexity: Extended, flexible language with a broad functional range of structures and vocabulary.
B2.cognitive_demand: Analysis, evaluation, synthesis, justification, inference, and problem solving.
B2.interaction_expectation: Sustained spontaneous interaction, negotiation of meaning, and development of ideas.
B2.scaffolding: Low; support is mainly strategic and used to refine performance.
B2.autonomy_expectation: High; learners manage tasks, strategies, and language choices independently.
B2.grammar_precision: Good control with attention to accuracy, flexibility, and appropriate complexity.
B2.fluency_expectation: Generally fluent and spontaneous, with hesitation mainly when developing complex ideas.
B2.register: Social, academic, and professional contexts with purposeful register choices.
B2.assessment_expectation: Demonstrate independent, effective communication, including developed ideas, justification, and appropriate language choices.
